)

select 
				 [SOL_ID]
				,[GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE]
				,[CRNCY_CODE]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[GL_SUB_HEAD_DESC]
				,[GL_CODE]
				,[GL_RPT_CODE]
				,[DR_BAL_AMT]
				,[CR_BAL_AMT]
				,[NUM_OF_ACCT_OPN]
				,[NUM_OF_ACCT_CLS]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[PURGE_DATE]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[TR_TRANSFER_MODE]
				,[LAST_TR_TRANSFER_DATE]
				,[TR_NUM]
				,[FREE_CODE1]
				,[FREE_CODE2]
				,[FREE_CODE3]
				,[FREE_CODE4]
				,[FREE_CODE5]
				,[GL_CLASSIFICATION_FLG]
				,[GL_SUB_HEAD_NATURE]
				,[ALT1_GL_SUB_HEAD_DESC]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT
				,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
				 [SOL_ID]
				,[GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE]
				,[CRNCY_CODE]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[GL_SUB_HEAD_DESC]
				,[GL_CODE]
				,[GL_RPT_CODE]
				,[DR_BAL_AMT]
				,[CR_BAL_AMT]
				,[NUM_OF_ACCT_OPN]
				,[NUM_OF_ACCT_CLS]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[PURGE_DATE]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[TR_TRANSFER_MODE]
				,[LAST_TR_TRANSFER_DATE]
				,[TR_NUM]
				,[FREE_CODE1]
				,[FREE_CODE2]
				,[FREE_CODE3]
				,[FREE_CODE4]
				,[FREE_CODE5]
				,[GL_CLASSIFICATION_FLG]
				,[GL_SUB_HEAD_NATURE]
				,[ALT1_GL_SUB_HEAD_DESC]
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME 
				,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_GLD_GLSUBHEADTABLE_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY     [SOL_ID]
				,[GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE]
				,[CRNCY_CODE]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[GL_SUB_HEAD_DESC]
				,[GL_CODE]
				,[GL_RPT_CODE]
				,[DR_BAL_AMT]
				,[CR_BAL_AMT]
				,[NUM_OF_ACCT_OPN]
				,[NUM_OF_ACCT_CLS]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[PURGE_DATE]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[TR_TRANSFER_MODE]
				,[LAST_TR_TRANSFER_DATE]
				,[TR_NUM]
				,[FREE_CODE1]
				,[FREE_CODE2]
				,[FREE_CODE3]
				,[FREE_CODE4]
				,[FREE_CODE5]
				,[GL_CLASSIFICATION_FLG]
				,[GL_SUB_HEAD_NATURE]
				,[ALT1_GL_SUB_HEAD_DESC]
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP

DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_GLD_GLSUBHEADTABLE]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.GLD_GLSUBHEADTABLE A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_GLD_GLSUBHEADTABLE_GROUP_SRC B 
ON COALESCE(A.SOL_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.SOL_ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE,'-1') = COALESCE(B.GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.CRNCY_CODE,'-1') = COALESCE(B.CRNCY_CODE,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BANK_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1
